reladraw
●
Syntax reference ↗ 

      
    


  

    
Cheatsheet

    
    
    
  

  

    
Statements

      
node api "API"a box, with its text

      
edge a -> ba line from a to b

      
edge a <- bthe same line, written target first

      
edge a <-> barrows at both ends

      
point p  2 above a top-centera named spot, to place against or pass through

      
region r  a top-left to c bottom-righta named area, from one corner to another

      
bundle trunk  via: through r horizontala path that lines share

      
guide node g  right of afor reference only; Guides in Settings shows it

      
style hot  fill: reda named look, worn with style: hot

      
default edge  line: (path: square)a look every edge wears; also node, leaf, container; the more specific wins

      
diagram theme: nord  background: #1e2229the whole diagram's theme and colors

      
The picture is drawn exactly as written: nothing moves to make room, and lines go only where they are told. Check reports anything that overlaps.

    

    
Placement

      
node b  right of abeside a, centered on it; also above, below, left of

      
node b  above-left of adiagonally, corner to corner; also above-right, below-left, below-right

      
node b  3 left of a and 2 above a3 units left of a, and 2 above it

      
node c  right of a and bagainst the box that just bounds a and b

      
node b  even with aon a's center line

      
node b  top even with atops in line; also bottom, left, right

      
node f  inside box top-rightin a corner of box

      
node g  outside box rightjust outside a side of box

      
node h  on box bottom-leftcentered on a part of box

      
node i  on between a and cmidway between a and c

      
node j  below down from b and left from aat the point straight down from b and left from a

      
The parts of a box: text, the sides top bottom left right, and top-left top-center top-right left-center center right-center bottom-left bottom-center bottom-right. One node is unplaced; every other is placed against something. Each axis is said once.

    

    
Gaps

      
node b  2 right of aexactly 2 units apart

      
node b  right of a (gap: wide)none, tight, normal or wide: 0, 2, 4 or 8 units

      
A box is about 4 units tall. A gap is exact.

    

    
Labels

      
node parserno text, so its name is its text

      
node parser ""deliberately blank

      
node a "two / lines"a space, slash and space breaks the line

    

    
Containment

      
node server.docker "Docker"a dotted name is a child; declare the parent first

      
node server  layout: columnchildren top to bottom, in written order; or row

      
layout: column (gap: tight, widths: match, align-children: left)how the children line up

      
layout: decka stack of cards, the first child in front

      
gather-children: leftwhere the children sit in spare room

      
shape: noneon a container, draws no box

      
Without a layout, one child is unplaced and the rest are placed against it.

    

    
Sizes

      
width: 3030 units wide

      
height: menuas tall as menu

      
height: 0.5 menu heighthalf as tall as menu

      
height: a top to c bottomfrom a's top to c's bottom

      
min-width: 10at least 10 units wide

    

    
Appearance

      
style: hotwear a named style

      
fill: #191728a box's color

      
border: noneno outline

      
corners: sharpsquare corners; boxes are rounded unless told

      
line: #d2904ea line's color

      
overlap: allowthis one may overlap without a finding

      
url: "https://example.com"a link, shown on the page

      
description: "What it does"shown on the page; never drawn

    

    
Lines

      
line: (path: square, corners: rounded)everything about a line goes in line:

      
line: (path: curved, curve: subtle)straight (the default), square or curved

      
line: (path: square, turn: 1/3, step-out: tight)where a square line turns, and how far it steps out

      
line: (crossing: arc)where lines cross: gap, arc, square or none

      
line: (pattern: dashed)solid, dashed, dotted or dash-dot

      
line: (thickness: thick)thin, normal, thick, a multiple, or 3px

    

    
Where lines go

      
from: right  to: leftleave and arrive at a side

      
to: bottom-centerarrive at a point on a side

      
to: left 3/4 downa fraction of the way along a side

      
via: c top, between a and bthe places a line passes, in order

      
via: through r horizontalstraight through a region

      
edge a -> b "calls" (at: start)where a line's text sits: start, 1/4, the middle by default

      
edge a -> b "calls" (above edge)text beside the line rather than on it

      
edge a -> b "calls" (on: longest level)text on the longest level stretch

      
A line runs straight between its two boxes, through anything in between, unless told otherwise.

    

    
Body

      
shape: documentrectangle, document, circle or none

      
node note "a note"  right of a  shape: nonejust text: an annotation

      
icon: databasethe node is the picture, with no box

      
badge: databasethe picture beside the text, in the box

      
layout: deck  cards: "v1" "v2"a stack of cards, one per text, front first

      
icon logo """<svg …>…</svg>"""your own picture, used as icon: logo

      
Pictures: disk desktop laptop package cubes cube database.

    

    
Text

      
node a "Server" (size: large)small, normal or large

      
node a "Server" (color: theme-muted)the text's color

      
node a "A long label" (wrap: 24)folds at 24 characters

      
node a "Server" (inside top, align: left)where a container's title sits: on top, outside top, center

      
style dim  text: (color: theme-muted)in a style, the bracket hangs off text:

      
node a "name / [dim]quieter[/dim]"those words in style dim's text color

      
node a "a \/ b"a slash that doesn't break the line; \[ for a bracket

    

    
Comments

      
// to the end of the lineanywhere, including after a statement

    

  

  
Nothing matches. Try one word, such as above, gap or color.
